title: Running out of context
intro: Your session is long and the context is nearly full. Pick an action.

show.title: See what's using space
show.detail: A breakdown shows how much goes to memory files, tools, MCP servers and messages.

show.title: Summarize, keep the key points
show.detail: Older turns are replaced by a summary that focuses on what you asked to keep.

show.title: Automatic compaction
show.detail: Near the limit, Claude Code compacts on its own so the session can continue.

show.title: Start over
show.detail: The context is emptied; the old session can still be resumed.

fallback.title: Pick an option
fallback.detail: Choose one of the options to see what happens.

quiz.question: How can you keep big file reads out of the main conversation?
quiz.explanation: Subagents work in their own context and return only a summary.
